summary_en: Shikoku Kasei announced a share buyback program with a maximum of 1.8 million shares (2.1% of outstanding shares) and a budget ceiling of 4.0 billion yen. Purchases will occur via market trading from the day after the share offering settlement through December 31, 2026.
summary_jp: 最大180万株、発行済株式数の2.1%、総額40億円を上限に自己株式を取得。株式売出しの受渡期日の翌営業日から2026年12月31日までの間、市場買付けで実施する。
